node.title: HGE4 primitive swap odd-moment router
node.statement: A primitive near-square union with antipodal swap stabilizer exists only at odd width. Its two supports are P and -P, and the odd elementary symmetric functions e_j(P), equivalently the odd power sums through j<h, vanish. Conversely these equations, antipodal-freeness, and trivial common scaling stabilizer reconstruct the primitive swap pair. Thus the swap branch is empty at even h; at odd h it reduces to a signed odd-Vandermonde kernel on h antipodal pairs, with A_h^swap=hV_h^swap<=binom(n/2-1,h-1). The free-union class and the aggregate HGE4 bound remain open.
